title: Ragi Kanji
description: A warm, mildly sweet finger millet porridge made with jaggery and milk, a nourishing breakfast for all ages.
steps: Mix the ragi flour with 100 ml of the water in a bowl and whisk to a smooth paste with no lumps.
Bring the remaining water to a boil in a saucepan and lower the heat.
Pour in the ragi paste slowly while stirring continuously so it does not clump.
Cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until the porridge thickens and loses its raw smell.
Add the jaggery powder, milk and cardamom powder and simmer for 2 minutes.
